CustomField.description: The Cybersecurity share of the MRR this quote gives up, written by FinancialMetricsService on every quote line change. Renewal: each Cybersecurity product on the contract that comes back smaller, or not at all, counted gross so a product that shrank still shows even when another Cybersecurity product grew. Amendment and Cancellation: the negative Cybersecurity lines. Blank, not zero, when nothing in Cybersecurity was lost.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Cybersecurity MRR this quote gives up, counted per product against the contract. A product that shrank still counts even if Cybersecurity grew overall. Blank means nothing was lost.
CustomField.label: Loss MRR - Cyber
